# Vencedores do The Game Awards 2024

O The Game Awards 2024 foi realizado em 12 de dezembro de 2024, no Peacock Theater, em Los Angeles. Aqui está a lista completa dos vencedores:

---

## 🏆 Principais Categorias

| Categoria | Vencedor |
|---|---|
| **Jogo do Ano (Game of the Year)** | **Astro Bot** (Team Asobi / Sony Interactive Entertainment) |
| **Melhor Direção de Jogo (Best Game Direction)** | **Astro Bot** (Team Asobi / Sony Interactive Entertainment) |
| **Melhor Narrativa (Best Narrative)** | **Metaphor: ReFantazio** (Studio Zero / Sega) |
| **Melhor Direção Artística (Best Art Direction)** | **Metaphor: ReFantazio** (Studio Zero / Sega) |
| **Melhor Trilha Sonora e Música (Best Score and Music)** | **Final Fantasy VII Rebirth** (Square Enix) |
| **Melhor Design de Áudio (Best Audio Design)** | **Astro Bot** (Team Asobi / Sony Interactive Entertainment) |
| **Melhor Performance (Best Performance)** | **Melina Juergens** como Senua (*Senua's Saga: Hellblade II*) |
| **Melhor Família (Best Family Game)** | **Astro Bot** (Team Asobi / Sony Interactive Entertainment) |
| **Melhor Jogo Independente (Best Independent Game)** | **Balatro** (LocalThunk / Playstack) |
| **Melhor Jogo Contínuo (Best Ongoing Game)** | **Helldivers II** (Arrowhead Game Studios) |
| **Melhor VR/AR (Best VR/AR Game)** | **Batman: Arkham Shadow** (Camouflaj / Oculus Studios) |
| **Melhor Ação/Adventure (Best Action/Adventure Game)** | **Black Myth: Wukong** (Game Science) |
| **Melhor RPG (Best Role Playing Game)** | **Metaphor: ReFantazio** (Studio Zero / Sega) |
| **Melhor Luta (Best Fighting Game)** | **Tekken 8** (Bandai Namco Studios) |
| **Melhor Esportes (Best Sports/Racing Game)** | **EA Sports FC 25** (EA Vancouver / EA Sports) |
| **Melhor Multijogador (Best Multiplayer Game)** | **Helldivers II** (Arrowhead Game Studios) |
| **Melhor Adaptação (Best Adaptation)** | **Prince of Persia: The Lost Crown** (Ubisoft Montpellier / Ubisoft) |

---

## 🏅 Prêmios Especiais

| Categoria | Vencedor |
|---|---|
| **Jogo do Ano (Game Changer Award)** | **Amir Satvat** (pela ajuda a desenvolvedores demitidos na indústria) |
| **Global Gaming Citizen** | **Laura Carter** (TreesPlease Games) |
| **Melhor Criador de Conteúdo (Content Creator of the Year)** | **CaseOh** |
| **Melhor Esportes Eletrônicos (Best Esports Game)** | **League of Legends** (Riot Games) |
| **Melhor Atleta de Esportes Eletrônicos (Best Esports Athlete)** | **Faker** (Lee "Faker" Sang-hyeok) |
| **Melhor Equipe de Esportes Eletrônicos (Best Esports Team)** | **T1** (League of Legends) |

---

## 📊 Estatísticas Gerais

- **Jogos com mais indicações:** *Astro Bot* e *Final Fantasy VII Rebirth* (7 cada)
- **Jogos com mais vitórias:** *Astro Bot* (4 vitórias)
- **Jogos mais indicados:** *Astro Bot* e *Final Fantasy VII Rebirth* (7 indicações cada)
- **Jogos que receberam múltiplos prêmios:** *Astro Bot* (4), *Balatro* (3), *Metaphor: ReFantazio* (3)

O vencedor mais surpreendente foi **Astro Bot**, que se tornou o terceiro jogo da história a vencer o Game of the Year (depois de *God of War* em 2018 e *The Last of Us Part II* em 2020), além de ser o primeiro jogo da Sony Interactive Entertainment a alcançar essa marca.

| ← [2023](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2023 "The Game Awards 2023") **·**   [The Game Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards "The Game Awards")   **·** [2025](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2025 "The Game Awards 2025") → | |

**The Game Awards 2024** was an award show to honor the best [video games of 2024](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Video_games_of_2024 "Video games of 2024"). It was the eleventh show hosted by [Geoff Keighley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geoff_Keighley "Geoff Keighley"), creator and producer of [the Game Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards "The Game Awards"), and held with a live audience at the [Peacock Theater](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peacock_Theater "Peacock Theater") in Los Angeles on December 12, 2024, and [live streamed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Live_stream "Live stream") across online platforms globally. It featured musical performances from [d4vd](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/D4vd "D4vd"), [Royal & the Serpent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Royal_&_the_Serpent "Royal & the Serpent"), [Snoop Dogg](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snoop_Dogg "Snoop Dogg"), and [Twenty One Pilots](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twenty_One_Pilots "Twenty One Pilots"), and presentations from celebrity guests including [Harrison Ford](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Harrison_Ford "Harrison Ford"), [Hideo Kojima](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hideo_Kojima "Hideo Kojima"), and [Aaron Paul](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Aaron_Paul "Aaron Paul").

*[Astro Bot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Astro_Bot "Astro Bot")* and *[Final Fantasy VII Rebirth](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Final_Fantasy_VII_Rebirth "Final Fantasy VII Rebirth")* led the nominees with seven each, and the former led the show with four wins, including [Game of the Year](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year "The Game Award for Game of the Year"). The inaugural Game Changer award honored [Amir Satvat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Amir_Satvat "Amir Satvat") for helping workers in the industry find jobs amid [mass layoffs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2022–2025_video_game_industry_layoffs "2022–2025 video game industry layoffs"). Several new games were announced, including *[Elden Ring Nightreign](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elden_Ring_Nightreign "Elden Ring Nightreign")*, *[Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intergalactic:_The_Heretic_Prophet "Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet")*, and *[The Witcher IV](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Witcher_IV "The Witcher IV")*. The show was viewed by over 154 million streams, the most in its history to date.[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Views-1) Journalists praised the game announcements, developer speeches, and deserving winners, though the eligibility of [downloadable content](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Downloadable_content "Downloadable content") led to mixed responses.

## Background

As with previous iterations of [the Game Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards "The Game Awards"), the 2024 show was hosted and produced by Canadian games journalist [Geoff Keighley](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geoff_Keighley "Geoff Keighley"). He returned as an executive producer alongside Kimmie Kim,[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Deadline_Nominees-2) while Richard Preuss returned as director and LeRoy Bennett as creative director and production designer,[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-ANN_Nominees-3)[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Variety_Preview-4) and Michael E. Peter joined as co-executive producer.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Variety_Viewers-5) The presentation, celebrating the show's tenth anniversary, took place at the [Peacock Theater](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peacock_Theater "Peacock Theater") in Los Angeles on December 12, 2024,[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-VGC_Date-6) and was [live streamed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Live_stream "Live stream") across more than 30 online platforms,[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-ANN_Nominees-3) including [Facebook](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Facebook "Facebook"), [Instagram](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Instagram "Instagram"), [Steam](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Steam_(service) "Steam (service)"), [TikTok](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TikTok "TikTok"), [Twitch](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twitch_(service) "Twitch (service)"), [Twitter](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twitter "Twitter"), and [YouTube](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/YouTube "YouTube").[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Polygon_Watch-7) Alternative live streams offering [American Sign Language](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/American_Sign_Language "American Sign Language") and [audio descriptions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Audio_description "Audio description") were also available on YouTube.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-ANN_Nominees-3)

The 2024 stage featured more [LED displays](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/LED_displays "LED displays") than its predecessors, an intentional choice by Bennett to change the show's look each year.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Variety_Preview-4) Sydnee Goodman returned as host of the 30-minute preshow, titled Opening Act.[[7]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-GamesHub_How-8)[[8]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-FAQ-9) Public tickets became available for purchase on November 1.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-VGC_Date-6) Future Class organizer Emily Bouchac indicated that the Future Class initiative—an annual list of 50 individuals from the industry who best represent its future, introduced in 2020—would not induct new members in 2024, instead focusing on valuing existing alumni.[[9]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Game_Developer_Future_Class-10)

### Announcements

Preceding the Game Awards, several announcements were made during broadcasts by Wholesome Games and the Latin American Games Showcase on December 10,[[10]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Wholesome-11)[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-VentureBeat_Showcases-12) and [Day of the Devs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Day_of_the_Devs "Day of the Devs") and the Women-Led Games Showcase on December 11.[[11]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-VentureBeat_Showcases-12)[[12]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Engadget_Devs-13) Fewer film and television announcements were made during the Game Awards 2024, instead focusing almost primarily on games; a preview for *[Squid Game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Squid_Game "Squid Game")*'s [second season](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Squid_Game_season_2 "Squid Game season 2") was aired, but considered secondary to the promotion of the game *Squid Game: Unleashed*.[[13]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Variety_Hollywood-14) Announcements on released and upcoming games were made for:[[14]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-GamesRadar_Live-15)

## Winners and nominees

Nominees were announced on November 18, 2024.[[17]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Variety_Nominees-18)[[18]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-VGC_Nominees-19) Any game released for public consumption on or before November 22 was eligible for consideration,[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Kotaku_Eligibility-20) including [downloadable content](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Downloadable_content "Downloadable content") (DLC), expansions, [remakes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Video_game_remake "Video game remake"), [remasters](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Video_game_remaster "Video game remaster"), and seasonal content.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Polygon_DLC-21) The nominees were compiled by a jury panel composed of members from over 130 media outlets globally;[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Hardcore_Gamer_Nominees-22) ballots were due by November 12.[[19]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Kotaku_Eligibility-20) Winners were determined between the jury (90 percent) and public voting (10 percent); the latter was held via the official website and on [Discord](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Discord "Discord")[[b]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-24) until December 11.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Deadline_Nominees-2)[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Game_Rant_Nominees-25) The exception was the publicly-voted Players' Voice, for which voting opened on December 2.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Push_Square_Voice-26) Specialized juries decided nominees for categories like accessibility, adaptation, and [esports](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Esports "Esports").[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Epic_Nominees-27) Two awards—Best Esports Coach and Best Esports Event—were discontinued,[[26]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Sheep_Esports-28)[[27]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-India_Today-29) while an additional honorary award, Game Changer, was introduced.[[28]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-IGN_Game_Changer-30) Approximately 112 million public votes were cast overall, a 25% increase from [2023](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2023 "The Game Awards 2023").[[29]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Game_Rant_Viewers-31)

As with the preceding year, the Game Awards partnered with map developer Studio 568 and artists Nighttimes and Spiral House to create an in-game hub world in *[Fortnite](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fortnite "Fortnite")*, allowing players to vote from November 25 to December 11 for their favorite user-created islands among ten nominees selected by Keighley and his team; the winner was announced during the ceremony.[[30]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Variety_Fortnite-32)[[31]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Epic_Fortnite-33) The hub world opened with a [photorealistic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Photorealistic "Photorealistic") "MetaHuman" model of Keighley,[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Aftermath_Fortnite-34) for which he was scanned in to [Unreal Editor for Fortnite](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unreal_Editor_for_Fortnite "Unreal Editor for Fortnite") at [3Lateral](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/3Lateral "3Lateral") in [Manchester](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Manchester "Manchester").[[33]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Push_Square_Fortnite-35) Several critics found the model strange and [uncanny](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Uncanny "Uncanny").[[32]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Aftermath_Fortnite-34)[[34]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Vice_Fortnite-36)[[35]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Fortnite-37) Keighley saw the event as "a prototype" for blending the Game Awards and in-game worlds.[[36]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-GameSpot_Fortnite-38)

The winners were announced during the awards ceremony on December 12, 2024.[[37]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-IGN_Winners-39) *[Astro Bot](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Astro_Bot "Astro Bot")* became the third game published by [Sony Interactive Entertainment](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sony_Interactive_Entertainment "Sony Interactive Entertainment") to win [Game of the Year](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Award_for_Game_of_the_Year "The Game Award for Game of the Year") (after *[God of War](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/God_of_War_(2018_video_game) "God of War (2018 video game)")* in [2018](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2018 "The Game Awards 2018") and *[The Last of Us Part II](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Last_of_Us_Part_II "The Last of Us Part II")* in [2020](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2020 "The Game Awards 2020")); its nomination marked Sony's ninth consecutive year in the category and thirteenth nomination overall.[[38]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_PlayStation-40) It was the second Best Family Game nominee to win the top prize (after *[It Takes Two](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/It_Takes_Two_(video_game) "It Takes Two (video game)")* in [2021](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2021 "The Game Awards 2021")).[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Polygon_GOTY-41) *[Balatro](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Balatro "Balatro")* was the first solo-developed Game of the Year nominee (and second card game after *[Hearthstone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hearthstone "Hearthstone")* in [2014](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2014 "The Game Awards 2014")),[[40]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Rolling_Stone_Balatro-42)[[41]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Game_Rant_Balatro-43) while *[Black Myth: Wukong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Black_Myth:_Wukong "Black Myth: Wukong")* was the first Chinese-developed nominee[[42]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Polygon_Nominees-44) and *[Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Elden_Ring_Shadow_of_the_Erdtree "Elden Ring Shadow of the Erdtree")* was the first DLC to be nominated.[[43]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-NPR_Nominees-45)

## Reception

### Nominees

Several games saw increased weekly sales following their nominations, including *Final Fantasy VII Rebirth* by 268% and *Metaphor: ReFantazio* by 172%,[[70]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Game_Rant_Sales-83) and *Balatro* had its second-highest-earning week on mobile and a 100% increase in [concurrent players](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concurrent_players "Concurrent players") on Steam.[[71]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-PocketGamer_Balatro-84)[[72]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-PCGamesN_Balatro-85)[[73]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Polygon_Balatro-86) *Balatro*'s nominations pleasantly surprised critics due to its genre,[[74]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Variety_Snubs-87)[[75]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Kotaku_Snubs-88)[[76]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Snubs-89) though some felt other [indie games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Indie_games "Indie games") remained overlooked outside of their dedicated categories.[[76]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Snubs-89)[[77]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Polygon_Analysis-90) *[TheGamer](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/TheGamer "TheGamer")*'s Stacey Henley appreciated that Games for Impact "can finally feel like part of the show" as, unlike previous years, some of its nominees were also named in other categories,[[78]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Impact-91) though *[The Guardian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Guardian "The Guardian")*'s Keza MacDonald found its nominees incongruous and criteria confusing.[[79]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Guardian_Nominees-92) Some felt three of the five Players' Voice nominees being [gacha games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gacha_game "Gacha game") justified the lack of more audience-voted categories.[[80]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Review-93)[[81]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Dot_Esports_Voice-94)

The omission of Future Class was criticized; *TheGamer*'s Tessa Kaur called it "a loss for the industry",[[82]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Future_Class-95) and *[Digital Trends](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_Trends "Digital Trends")*'s Giovanni Colantonio considered it a troubling indication that Keighley was attempting to avoid controversy and placate the audience in light of an open letter written by Future Class inductees before the 2023 ceremony.[[80]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Review-93) Some critics were puzzled by *[Silent Hill 2](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Silent_Hill_2_(2024_video_game) "Silent Hill 2 (2024 video game)")*'s Best Narrative nomination as it is a remake of [a 2001 game](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Silent_Hill_2 "Silent Hill 2").[[76]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Snubs-89)[[83]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-AV_Club_DLC-96) *[Dragon Age: The Veilguard](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dragon_Age:_The_Veilguard "Dragon Age: The Veilguard")*, *[EA Sports College Football 25](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/EA_Sports_College_Football_25 "EA Sports College Football 25")*, and *[The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Legend_of_Zelda:_Echoes_of_Wisdom "The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom")* were considered among the biggest snubs by some critics and viewers.[[75]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Kotaku_Snubs-88)[[84]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Polygon_Snubs-97)[[85]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Shacknews_Snubs-98)

Many journalists and viewers criticized *Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree*'s Game of the Year nomination as it overshadowed other games,[[74]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Variety_Snubs-87)[[86]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-BBC_GOTY-99)[[87]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Vice_DLC-100) though some felt it was justified by its quality and size.[[75]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Kotaku_Snubs-88)[[83]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-AV_Club_DLC-96)[[88]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Deserves-101) The show's website was updated before nominees were announced to clarify DLC's eligibility, which many predicted was in preparation for *Shadow of the Erdtree*'s divisive nominations;[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Polygon_DLC-21)[[87]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Vice_DLC-100)[[89]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-VGC_DLC-102) some viewers erroneously accused Keighley of changing the rules to make it eligible.[[90]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Rules-103) Others also felt its eligibility meant DLC was snubbed at previous shows, like *[Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cyberpunk_2077:_Phantom_Liberty "Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty")* and *[Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Future Redeemed](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xenoblade_Chronicles_3:_Future_Redeemed "Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Future Redeemed")* in 2023,[[91]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Cyberpunk-104)[[92]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Destructoid_DLC-105)[[93]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Nintendo_Life_DLC-106) and suggested a new category dedicated to DLC would be more appropriate,[[75]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Kotaku_Snubs-88)[[94]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-IGN_GOTY-107)[[95]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-GamesRadar_DLC-108) though *TheGamer*'s Henley argued there are too few annual releases to justify it.[[96]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_DLC-109)

Some journalists considered *Black Myth: Wukong* an [outlier](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Outlier "Outlier") in the Game of the Year nominees and were surprised by its success;[[84]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Polygon_Snubs-97)[[86]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-BBC_GOTY-99) it is the lowest-scoring Game of the Year nominee in the show's history, with 81 out of 100 on [review aggregator](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Review_aggregator "Review aggregator") website [Metacritic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Metacritic "Metacritic").[[97]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Polygon_Metacritic-110)[[98]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Metacritic-111) *TheGamer*'s Tessa Kaur felt the game's biggest accomplishment was its popularity, comparing it to *[Barbie](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Barbie_(film) "Barbie (film)")*'s [Best Picture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Academy_Award_for_Best_Picture "Academy Award for Best Picture") nomination at the [Academy Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/96th_Academy_Awards "96th Academy Awards").[[99]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Wukong-112) Conversely, *[Vice](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vice_(magazine) "Vice (magazine)")*'s Dwayne Jenkins criticized journalists who questioned its deservedness based solely on its critical reception, despite the positive player response; he argued that such discussions are more appropriate for audiences rather than journalists, who should serve as [neutral intermediaries](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Journalistic_objectivity "Journalistic objectivity"), since the awards have no objective criteria.[[100]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Vice_Wukong-113)

### Ceremony

*[The Washington Post](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Washington_Post "The Washington Post")*'s Gene Park called the 2024 ceremony "the best show put on by the Game Awards so far this decade", though he felt the categories required better curation,[[101]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-WP_Review-114) and *[Engadget](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Engadget "Engadget")*'s Mat Smith wrote that "the Game Awards delivered".[[102]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Engadget_After-115) *[VentureBeat](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/VentureBeat "VentureBeat")*'s [Dean Takahashi](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dean_Takahashi "Dean Takahashi") thought Keighley "redeemed himself" after criticism of the previous ceremony,[[47]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-VentureBeat_Review-49) and *[Push Square](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Push_Square "Push Square")*'s Sammy Barker felt he deserved credit for responding to past criticism, even if some problems remained.[[103]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Push_Square_Review-116) *Digital Trends*'s Colantonio called it "the best possible version" of the show, though he criticized the relegation of important awards to the preshow.[[80]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Review-93) *[Rolling Stone](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling_Stone "Rolling Stone")*'s Issy van der Velde similarly criticized that the esports winners were announced in quick succession during the preshow without acceptance speeches,[[104]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Rolling_Stone_Review-117) and *TheGamer*'s Kaur felt the show remained too long and padded with boring advertisements, though found the reveals surprising "for the first time in a long time".[[105]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Surprises-118)

Journalists deemed the winners deserving, including *Astro Bot*'s Game of the Year award considering its polished and joyful gameplay;[[39]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Polygon_GOTY-41)[[101]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-WP_Review-114)[[102]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Engadget_After-115) the game's sales saw an increase after its win, according to estimates published by Alinea Analytics.[[106]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Alinea-119) Many writers considered the game announcements surprising and among the best to date;[[80]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Review-93)[[102]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Engadget_After-115)[[104]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Rolling_Stone_Review-117) *The Guardian*'s MacDonald compared it to "an old-school [E3](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/E3 "E3") conference".[[107]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Guardian_Review-120) Viewers responded negatively to *[Catly](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catly "Catly")*'s reveal trailer;[[104]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Rolling_Stone_Review-117)[[108]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Catly-121)[[109]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Catly-122) the developer denied claims of [generative AI](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Generative_AI "Generative AI") and [blockchain](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blockchain "Blockchain") technology, and shared a draft version of the trailer with journalists.[[110]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-IGN_Catly-123)[[111]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Game_Developer_Catly-124)[[112]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Catly_2-125) The musical performances were praised;[[80]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Review-93)[[113]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-NME_Arcane-126) *[NME](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/NME "NME")*'s Surej Singh called the *Arcane* performance an "emotional and stirring medley".[[113]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-NME_Arcane-126) Several commentators appreciated the additional time for acceptance speeches, following criticism at the previous ceremony.[[80]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Review-93)[[104]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Rolling_Stone_Review-117) *[Kotaku](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kotaku "Kotaku")*'s Zack Zwiezen considered Statler and Waldorf the highlight for their humorous interjections and heckles directed at Keighley,[[114]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Kotaku_Muppets-127) though *TheGamer*'s Kaur felt their appearance acknowledged the show's issues without addressing them.[[115]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Muppets-128)

Many considered the Game Changer award and Amir Satvat's emotional acceptance speech the show's highlight;[[61]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-BBC_Winners-71)[[80]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Digital_Trends_Review-93)[[101]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-WP_Review-114) *Rolling Stone*'s Van der Velde thought the award meant Keighley was taking criticism seriously,[[104]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Rolling_Stone_Review-117) though *TheGamer*'s Kaur and Henley felt its introduction in the same year as Future Class's removal gave the appearance of awarding individuals to reduce the voice of a collective group.[[115]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Muppets-128)[[116]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Satvat-129) Some Future Class members were concerned the award had replaced the program as "it's easier to control one person's message than the message of multiple years Future Class members".[[117]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Aftermath_Future_Class-130) Some viewers suggested Satvat's role at [Tencent](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tencent "Tencent") made him "part of the problem" with layoffs.[[117]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Aftermath_Future_Class-130)[[118]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-PC_Gamer_Satvat-131) Four days after the show, Satvat said he had received "countless hateful messages", including [antisemitic](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Antisemitic "Antisemitic") comments directed at his ### Viewership

An estimated 154 million viewers watched the ceremony, the most in the show's history to date[[a]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Views-1) and a 31% increase from the previous year.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Variety_Viewers-5) Its figures surpassed the average viewers of the [Super Bowl](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Super_Bowl_LVIII "Super Bowl LVIII") by 30 million, the Academy Awards sevenfold, the [Grammy Awards](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/66th_Annual_Grammy_Awards "66th Annual Grammy Awards") ninefold, and the [World Series](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_World_Series "2024 World Series") tenfold.[[136]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-VentureBeat_Viewers-150) Referencing the viewing figures, [Reggie Fils-Aimé](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Reggie_Fils-Aimé "Reggie Fils-Aimé") called the show "the biggest global entertainment event of our time",[[137]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Push_Square_Viewers-151) though *TheGamer*'s Kaur considered the claim disingenuous, citing the [FIFA World Cup finals](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/FIFA_World_Cup_finals "FIFA World Cup finals") and [Olympic Games](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Olympic_Games "Olympic Games"), and the fact that shows like the Super Bowl are generally viewed in groups rather than individually.[[138]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-TheGamer_Viewers-152)

According to *Streams Charts*, the ceremony peaked at over four million concurrent viewers—the most in its history to date and a 10% increase from 2023—across 1,498 channels, including 1.25 million viewers on the official YouTube broadcast and 397,000 on Twitch.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Variety_Viewers-5)[[139]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-Game_Rant_Streams-153) More than 15,900 content creators co-streamed the event, including over 11,000 on Twitch and a record 4,500 on YouTube.[[136]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-VentureBeat_Viewers-150) On YouTube, the ceremony peaked at 2.17 million concurrent viewers (a 28% increase), with over 1.3 million on the official channel (a 35% increase).[[140]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-GamesIndustry_Viewers-154) On Twitter, usage of the [hashtag](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hashtag "Hashtag") #TheGameAwards increased by 150%, with more than 1.59 million posts receiving 6.79 billion [impressions](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Impression_(online_media) "Impression (online media)").[[141]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Game_Awards_2024#cite_note-ANN_Viewers-155)

conversa_com_ferramentas.content:
# ExaRanker:Explanation-Augmented Neural Ranker

Thiago Laitz Affiliation: FEEC, UNICAMP, Brazil Affiliation: NeuralMind, Brazil Roberto Lotufo Affiliation: FEEC, UNICAMP, Brazil Affiliation: NeuralMind, Brazil Rodrigo Nogueira Affiliation: FEEC, UNICAMP, Brazil Affiliation: NeuralMind, Brazil

###### Abstract

Recent work has shown that inducing a large language model (LLM) to generate explanations prior to outputting an answer is an effective strategy to improve performance on a wide range of reasoning tasks. In this work, we show that neural rankers also benefit from explanations. We use LLMs such as GPT-3.5 to augment retrieval datasets with explanations and train a sequence-to-sequence ranking model to output a relevance label and an explanation for a given query-document pair. Our model, dubbed ExaRanker, finetuned on a few thousand examples with synthetic explanations performs on par with models finetuned on 3x more examples without explanations.
Furthermore, the ExaRanker model incurs no additional computational cost during ranking, and allows explanations to be requested on demand. Code and data are available at <https://github.com/unicamp-dl/ExaRanker>

## 1 Introduction

Pretrained transformers such as BERT [[9](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib9 "")] and T5 [[34](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib34 "")] finetuned on hundreds of thousands of examples brought significant gains to information retrieval (IR) tasks [[23](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib23 ""), [30](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib30 ""), [26](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib26 ""), [22](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib22 ""), [14](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib14 ""), [58](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib58 ""), [60](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib60 ""), [17](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib17 ""), [12](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib12 ""), [25](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib25 ""), [43](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib43 ""), [16](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib16 ""), [50](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib50 ""), [64](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib64 "")].
When queries and documents from a task of interest are similar to the ones in the finetuning data, it is likely that a model will have an effectiveness better than that of unsupervised models. For example, a monoT5 [[31](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib31 "")] reranker finetuned on 400k positive query-passage pairs from MS MARCO [[1](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib1 "")] outperforms BM25 [[38](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib38 "")] in 15 of 18 datasets of the BEIR benchmark [[40](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib40 ""), [39](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib39 "")].

However, when the number of labeled examples is limited, the effectiveness of the model decreases significantly. For example, a BERT reranker finetuned on a mere 10k query-relevant passage pairs performs only slightly better than BM25 on the MS MARCO passage ranking benchmark [[31](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib31 "")].
Increasing the model size [[40](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib40 "")] or pretraining it on IR-specific objectives [[19](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib19 ""), [13](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib13 "")] alleviate the need for more finetuning data, at the expense of increased computational resources.

We argue that one reason neural retrievers need extensive amounts of training examples is that they are finetuned with categorical labels (e.g., true/false).
These labels provide limited information about the task to be learned, making it more challenging for the model to grasp the nuances of the task.
For example, imagine attempting to teach a human to evaluate the relevance of passages to queries, but only being able to communicate the words “true” or “false” per query-passage pair. The learning process would be more efficient if explanations in natural language were provided to explain why a passage is relevant or not to a given query.

In this work, we propose a method for training retrieval models using natural language explanations as additional labels, which reduces the need for training examples.
Furthermore, we show that few-shot LLMs such as GPT-3.5 [[33](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib33 "")] can be effectively employed to automatically augment training examples with explanations, enabling IR practitioners to apply our method to other datasets without the need for manual annotation. Our findings indicate that the utility of incorporating explanations decreases as the number of training examples increases. Furthermore, our experimental results demonstrate that finetuning a model to generate a label prior to an explanation leads to superior performance in comparison to generating an explanation before the target label. This outcome may be counterintuitive and contradicts previous findings in chain-of-thought works[[27](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib27 "")].

## 2 Related Work

Recent research has shown that inducing a large language model to generate step-by-step rationales in natural language improves performance in various tasks that require reasoning [[36](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib36 ""), [10](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib10 ""), [59](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib59 ""), [62](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib62 ""), [32](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib32 ""), [21](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib21 ""), [63](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib63 ""), [18](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib18 ""), [5](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib5 "")].
However, experiments using induced explanations are typically carried out on models with billions of parameters, which are impractical to use in information retrieval tasks. For example, reranking 100 passages for one query using a model with 175B parameters would take at least one minute on four A100 GPUs.
In this work, we propose a method to distill the knowledge from these large models and effectively use it to improve the quality of results in a ranking task.

Our method is related to InPars [[3](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib3 ""), [20](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib20 "")], Promptagator [[8](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib8 "")] and UPR [[42](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib42 "")], with the distinction that we augment existing target labels from training datasets with additional information relevant to the task at hand, rather than generating queries from documents. We view InPars and Promptagator as complementary to our method, and anticipate potential integration of these approaches in future research.

A large body of work addresses the task of generating explanations for a ranked list of results [[45](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib45 ""), [46](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib46 ""), [55](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib55 ""), [52](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib52 ""), [41](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib41 ""), [47](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib47 ""), [11](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib11 ""), [44](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib44 ""), [48](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib48 ""), [35](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib35 ""), [65](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib65 ""), [56](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib56 ""), [61](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib61 ""), [29](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib29 "")].
For example, GenEx [[35](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib35 "")] generates noun phrases (e.g., “impacts on medicare tax”) for a given query-document pair.
Snippet generation can also be regarded as providing explanations for why certain results are being presented to the user [[53](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib53 ""), [54](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib54 ""), [2](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib2 ""), [6](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib6 "")].
A key distinction of these works in comparison to ours is that our goal is to use explanations as a means to improve the effectiveness of a retrieval model, rather than solely for the purpose of explaining a list of results to users.
We do not claim that our method makes a retriever interpretable as we have not evaluated the correctness of the generated explanations. Our goal here is orthogonal to that of building interpretable retrievers: we show that explanations improve the effectiveness of retrievers. Nevertheless, our method may help users to understand a ranked list of results, but further examination of this aspect is left for future research.

## 3 Methodology

The proposed method is illustrated in Figure [1](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#S3.F1 "Figure 1 ‣ 3 Methodology ‣ ExaRanker:Explanation-Augmented Neural Ranker"). It starts by generating explanations for query-passage-label triples using an LLM model with in-context examples. These training triples are then augmented with the generated explanations, and a sequence-to-sequence model is finetuned to produce the target label followed by the explanation. In the inference phase, the finetuned model is used to estimate the relevance of a query-passage pair, based solely on the probability assigned to the label token.

![Refer to caption](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2/FIG1.png)Figure 1: Method overview.

We begin by randomly selecting 15k pairs of (query, relevant passage) and another 15k pairs of (query, non-relevant passage) from the training set of MS MARCO passage ranking dataset, and then generate explanations for these 30k pairs. Manually generating explanations for such a large volume of text would be
cost-prohibitive, so we use text-davinci-00211 1 beta.openai.com with a few-shot prompt to infer explanations for query-passage-label triples. We use greedy decoding, and the output is limited to 256 tokens.
The few-shot prompt, illustrated in Figure [2](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#S3.F2 "Figure 2 ‣ 3 Methodology ‣ ExaRanker:Explanation-Augmented Neural Ranker"), contains 7 examples that were selected from the MS MARCO training dataset, and has an average of 1400 tokens, including the 256 tokens of the explanation to be generated. As of January 2023, generating an explanation for each query-passage-label triple costs 0.028 USD using the OpenAI API. Due to cost constraints, the dataset was limited to 30k examples, which amounts to 840 USD.

![Refer to caption](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2/TABLE1.png)Figure 2: Prompt used to generate explanations for a query-passage-label triple (presented in Python’s f-string notation).

Note that we also use the label (relevant or not relevant) in the prompt and request only the explanation for the triple query-passage-label. In preliminary experiments, we noticed that the model generates better explanations when the label is provided, as it is not confounded by the classification task and can focus specifically on the explanation.

Once the 30k explanations are generated, a sequence-to-sequence model is finetuned with the following input/output templates (shown using Python’s f-string notation):

Input:   Is the question {query} answered by the {passage}? Give an explanation.

Output:   {label}. Explanation: {explanation}

The terms {query} and {passage} are the query-passage pair extracted from the MS MARCO dataset. The {label} is true if the passage is relevant to the query and false otherwise. Finally, {explanation} is the one generated by the LLM as explained above. Figure [3](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#S3.F3 "Figure 3 ‣ 3 Methodology ‣ ExaRanker:Explanation-Augmented Neural Ranker") illustrates examples of input and output generated by the model.

![Refer to caption](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2/FIG2.png)Figure 3: Illustration of input and generated outputs of a relevant (green) and non-relevant (red) query-passage pair.

The T5-base model was used as the starting point for the finetuning phase. The model was finetuned for 30 epochs using the AdamW optimizer [[24](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib24 "")] with a learning rate of 3e-5, weight decay of 0.01, and batch size of 128 examples (64 positives and 64 negatives). The maximum number of input and output tokens were each limited to 512. Sequences exceeding these values were truncated during both training and inference. For comparison purposes, a T5-base model was also finetuned using the same hyperparameters and dataset, but without the inclusion of explanations in the target text.

After finetuning, we evaluate the models on a passage ranking task. The input to the model is the same as presented before, and, as a consequence, it generates the same output pattern.22 2 In our experiments the model always generates an output that matches the target template. The probability of the first output token is used as the relevance score <!-- MathML: <math display="inline" alttext="s" intent=":literal" id="S3.p9.m1"><semantics><mi>s</mi><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s</annotation></semantics></math> --> ss for the query-passage pair:

We limit the model to generate only the label for the query-passage pair (i.e., the first token) and omit the full explanation text to save processing time. Since the model was trained with causal mask, that is, only tokens generated so far influence the prediction of the next token, the relevance scores are the same had the model generated an explanation.
Alternatively, explanations can generated by decoding more tokens until the termination token (e.g., <EOS>) is generated.

To evaluate the real benefits of explanation in a more realistic scenario in which training data is not available, we evaluate the model in a zero-shot manner on 6 datasets from the BEIR benchmark [[51](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib51 "")]: Robust04 [[57](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib57 "")], TREC-COVID [[37](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib37 "")], DBPedia [[15](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib15 "")], FiQA [[28](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib28 "")], TREC-NEWS [[49](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib49 "")] and NFCorpus [[4](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib4 "")]. TREC-DL 2020 [[7](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#bib.bib7 "")] is used as a validation set to select the best checkpoint and hyperparameters.

## 4 Results

Main results are presented in Table [1](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#S4.T1 "Table 1 ‣ 4 Results ‣ ExaRanker:Explanation-Augmented Neural Ranker"). The first two rows are the BM25 baseline and the monoT5-base model finetuned on 400k positive query-passage pairs from the MS MARCO dataset for one epoch33 3 <https://huggingface.co/castorini/monot5-base-msmarco-10k>. We focus our analysis on the number of positive query-passage pairs as these need to be manually annotated. Thus they are an expensive component when developing a search engine. Negative query-passage pairs can be automatically selected using a retriever once queries are gathered. We also need to generate explanations for negative query-passage pairs, but we assume this cost will decrease over time with the increased availability of open-sourced LLMs.

In the third and fourth rows, we compare models finetuned using the same hyperparameters and examples, but without explanations (monoT5) and with explanations (ExaRanker). The ExaRanker model outperforms the model without explanations in all 7 datasets. On average, it improves the score by 0.8 nDCG@10 points in the zero-shot evaluation.

Compared to the BM25 baseline, the finetuned models have a much higher nDCG@10 scores. Also, ExaRanker finetuned on 15k and 10k positive examples are on average 1.7 nDCG@10 points behind monoT5-400k, which has been finetuned on 400k positive examples. This result shows the benefits of using the explanation to provide more data and reasoning during the training phase, and enable the model to succeed with much less training data.

Table 1: Main results (nDCG@10), including average zero-shot (all except DL 20). The column “Ft Pos.” is the number of positive training examples on which the model was finetuned.

To better understand the benefits of using explanations, we have reproduced the training methodology with smaller datasets: 20k, 10k and 5k examples. All datasets have an equal number of positive and negative query-passage pairs.

The ExaRanker model outperforms the model finetuned without explanations in all cases. It reinforces the evidence of the benefits of using explanations and indicates that the model benefits more when datasets are smaller. When finetuning on 15k positive examples, ExaRanker performs 0.8 points better than monoT5. When finetuned on 10k examples, the improvement is 1.1 points and increases to 2.6 when finetuned on 5k positive examples.

Figure [4](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#S4.F4 "Figure 4 ‣ 4 Results ‣ ExaRanker:Explanation-Augmented Neural Ranker") provides a visualization of this trend. We see that the improvement in using explanations decreases as the number of samples increases. However, we see a performance increase when explanations are used to augment labels compared to finetuning without explanations. Comparing the monoT5 results finetuned using 15k positive pairs with ExaRanker using 5k positive pairs, we see that the average scores are very close but ExaRanker uses 3x less data for finetuning. These results suggest that data augmentation through explanations is an effective way to transfer knowledge from larger models.

![Refer to caption](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2/ExaRanker_linear.png)Figure 4: Average zero-shot results on 6 datasets of the BEIR benchmark when varying the number of training examples. monoT5-400k is finetuned on the 400k relevant query-passage pairs from MS MARCO without explanations.

### 4.1 Qualitative Analysis

Table [2](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#S4.T2 "Table 2 ‣ 4.1 Qualitative Analysis ‣ 4 Results ‣ ExaRanker:Explanation-Augmented Neural Ranker") presents some sample outputs for a qualitative comparison of the correct and incorrect predictions made by ExaRanker on the TREC-DL 2020 dataset. The model is able to generate reasonable explanations: in the second example, it was able to understand the context, correctly predicting the relevance of the passage, even though it only mentions specific terms from the query, such as “early pregnancy”. However, it may struggle with more fine-grained relationships, such as correctly identifying the relationship between electromagnetic waves and radio waves, as shown in the third example. Overall, explanations appear to support a better understanding of the relationship between the query and the passage, both quantitatively and qualitatively.

In summary, the purpose of this method is to use the explanations to provide more information on how to perform the ranking task.
However, the models do not necessarily rely on reasoning to arrive at an answer. The explanations are used to expedite the learning process, but the most relevant score for ranking the relationship between sequences is concentrated in the label score, specifically the true or false label indicating the relevance relation, rather than in the entire explanation generated.

### 4.2 Ablation Experiments

Two additional experiments were conducted to better understand the contribution of adding explanations as target sequences in a ranking task.

First we finetuned another ExaRanker model for 30 epochs, with the same hyperparameters but inverting the order in which label and explanations are generated: first an explanation is generated, then a relevance label. It is reasonable to expect that this order would lead to better results, as it induces the model to elaborate on the relationship between query and passage prior to predicting a label. However, as shown in Table [3](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#S4.T3 "Table 3 ‣ 4.2 Ablation Experiments ‣ 4 Results ‣ ExaRanker:Explanation-Augmented Neural Ranker"), the nDCG@10 score dropped 9.6 points compared to generating a relevance label followed by an explanation. We believe that this behavior is due to the difficulty of using a ranking score from multiple tokens. We tried different approaches, such as using the average token probabilities of the entire sequence or using only the probability of the final token (true or false). In all cases, nDCG@10 was lower than the method described in Section [3](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#S3 "3 Methodology ‣ ExaRanker:Explanation-Augmented Neural Ranker").

Table 3: Ablation of the output template. Results are on TREC DL 2020 and the models were finetuned on 15k positive + 15k negative examples.

In a second ablation study, we tested if explanations would improve a model already finetuned on a large ranking dataset. For that, we further finetuned on 15k positive + 15k negative examples with explanations a monoT5-base model already finetuned on 400k positive pairs from MS MARCO. Results in Table [4](https://arxiv.org/html/2301.10521v2#S4.T4 "Table 4 ‣ 4.2 Ablation Experiments ‣ 4 Results ‣ ExaRanker:Explanation-Augmented Neural Ranker") show a negligible difference of 0.2 nDCG@10 points compared to the model finetuned only on labels. As explained before, we expect the benefits of explanations to be reduced when large training data is available. This experiment demonstrated, however, that finetuning on explanations does not negatively affect a ranker’s effectiveness while equipping it with the capability of generating explanations for its relevance predictions.

Table 4: Results on finetuning Exaranker from a monoT5-base model finetuned on 400k positive examples from MS MARCO.

## 5 Conclusion

We have proposed a method for training information retrieval (IR) models using natural language explanations as additional labels, which reduces the need for a large number of training examples. Our results demonstrate that the use of explanations can significantly improve the performance of IR models, particularly when fewer labeled examples are available.

Finally, we showed that large language models can be used to effectively generate these explanations, thus allowing our method to be applied to other IR domains and tasks. Importantly, our method does not significantly increase the time required to rerank passages as only the true/false token is used during inference. The source code and datasets used in this study are available for public use in the accompanying repository for future research and advancements of the ExaRanker method.

![the logo](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/student/dsc/svg/logos/the-logo.svg?1)

## Find the best universities in Brazil using *Times Higher Education*’s Latin America University Rankings 2026. This table has been put together using a trusted methodology that ranks universities on teaching quality, research output and international outlook

## Top universities in Brazil 2026

## Key insights into the Brazil University Rankings 2026

- Brazil is among the world’s fastest-growing major economies, with economic reforms that are constantly pushing it forward on the international stage.
- There are 68 universities from Brazil in the [Latin America University Rankings 2026](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2026/latin-america-university-rankings). It is the most-represented country in the ranking
- Brazilian universities take seven places in the top 10
- The [University of São Paulo](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/university-sao-paulo) is the top-ranked Brazilian university and is also the top institution in the Latin America University Rankings

## Choosing a university in Brazil

Brazil is South America’s fastest-growing economy and this is reflected in the many university options in the bustling cities of Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo, among others. Public university education is free for international and domestic students, so students will most likely only have to pay a registration fee. Private universities do charge fees and this will depend on the course and university.

The table for the best universities in Brazil was derived from data collected from the *THE* Latin America University Rankings. The results are calculated using 18 performance indicators underlying five metrics: research environment, teaching (the learning environment), research quality, industry and international outlook. For more insights and a detailed breakdown of our ranking methodology, [visit our methodology page](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/latin-america-university-rankings-2026-methodology). Use the Brazil university ranking table above to explore the right institution for you.

# Unicamp is ranked 2nd in the THE Latin America ranking

Unicamp is the second best university in Latin America, according to a ranking released this Wednesday (3) by Times Higher Education (THE) Latin America University 2026, considered one of the main international instruments for evaluating universities in Latin America and the Caribbean.

In the 2026 edition, the ranking classified 223 universities from 16 countries. Brazil remains the country with the largest presence, with 69 universities evaluated, both public and private. Among the top ten institutions in the region, seven are Brazilian. The indicators were constructed based on an analysis of 174,9 million citations related to 18,7 million scientific publications indexed in the Scopus database between 2020 and 2024.

The calculation of teaching and research indicators incorporated the results of the 2024 and 2025 reputation surveys, totaling more than 108 responses from academics and employers worldwide.

[**See the full ranking.**](https://www.timeshighereducation.com/world-university-rankings/2026/latin-america-university-rankings?utm_source=ranking&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=latam&utm_content=embargo&spMailingID=32233028&spUserID=MTY1MDgwNjg4MjUyMwS2&spJobID=2850036803&spReportId=Mjg1MDAzNjgwMwS2)

With this performance, Unicamp maintained the second position it obtained in 2024, since the 2025 survey was not published due to methodological changes. In this 2026 edition, the organization responsible for the research introduced changes in which, for the first time, Latin American universities were evaluated in comparison with the global population of institutions present in the world ranking, and not just among themselves.

Created in 2016, THE Latin America uses the same core indicators as the THE World University Rankings, but with weights adjusted to reflect the institutional characteristics of the region.

![The Vice-Rector for University Development, Fernando Sarti: consistency of institutional work. ](https://www.unicamp.br/wp-content/uploads/sites/33/2025/12/Man_20251203_THE_AJS_8729_interna.jpg)**The Vice-Rector for University Development, Fernando Sarti: consistency of institutional work.**

Among the five pillars that make up the THE Latin America University Ranking, Unicamp stands out especially in two dimensions. First, in the Education dimension, with a score of 58,7, Unicamp occupies the 2nd position in Latin America.

In the Research Environment indicator, Unicamp also shows excellent performance, with a score of 52,3, which corresponds to the 2nd position in the Latin American ranking.

The other research indicator used is Research Quality, in which Unicamp ranks 4th, with a score of 69,1. Another highlight is the Industry dimension, which includes revenue from industry and patent citations.

In this regard, Unicamp has a score of 78,1, which places it in 4th position among all universities in Latin America.

“Unicamp’s continued ranking among the best universities in Latin America demonstrates the consistency of our institutional work and our ongoing commitment to academic quality, cutting-edge research, and social impact,” said the Pro-Rector for University Development (PRDU), Fernando Sarti. “Even with the methodological change introduced by THE in 2026, the university maintains its prominent position, which reinforces the solidity of our university development policies,” he added.

![PRDU faculty advisor, Renato Garcia: balanced performance across the main pillars evaluated.](https://www.unicamp.br/wp-content/uploads/sites/33/2025/12/Man_20251203_THE_AJS_3898_interna.jpg)**PRDU faculty advisor, Renato Garcia: balanced performance across the main pillars evaluated.**

PRDU's faculty advisor, Renato Garcia, believes that the changes in methodology have made the grading process more challenging.

“The result confirms Unicamp’s balanced performance in the main pillars evaluated, especially in teaching, research environment, and interaction with industry,” assesses Garcia. “The new methodology, which compares Latin American universities to the global set of institutions in the world ranking, makes the classification more challenging. Even so, Unicamp maintains its 2nd position, which demonstrates the robustness of our structural indicators,” he affirms.

Rector Paulo Cesar Montagner said that Unicamp's objective is to seek excellence in teaching, research, and outreach. "We remain firm in our purpose of building an ever-better university," he said.

“We want to continue pursuing what we believe in, so that we can make the University increasingly qualified in all its areas. The ranking position should be the result of hard work,” he concludes.

***Indicators***

The classification is structured around 16 indicators, distributed across five dimensions (pillars):

• Teaching (35%): reputation, institutional revenue, doctoral and faculty-to-student ratios.

• Research Environment (33,5%): reputation, productivity, and research revenue.

• Research Quality (20%): strength, excellence, and influence (citations) of scientific production.

• International Perspective (7,5%): students, international faculty, and global collaboration.

• Industry (4%): income derived from contracts and technological impact via patent citations.

![The university is listed among the "Best Employers in Brazil," in a ranking compiled by the American magazine Time. ](https://www.unicamp.br/wp-content/uploads/sites/33/2025/02/Ni_20250228_Bolsas_scarpa_AJS_3024-Capa.jpg)**The university is listed among the "Best Employers in Brazil," according to a ranking compiled by the American magazine. *Time***

***Unicamp is one of the best places to work in Brazil, research shows.***

Unicamp has entered the list of "Best Employers in Brazil," according to a ranking compiled by the American magazine *Time* in partnership with the data platform Statista. The University occupies 43rd place among the 500 listed and became the first educational institution and the only public one among the top 100 ranked.

Through an open-ended question, participants were asked to indicate their current employer and whether they would recommend them to friends and family, as well as their willingness to recommend other employers in the same sector. In addition to recommendations, they also evaluated their employers on aspects such as professional recognition, growth opportunities, a culture of innovation, diversity, inclusion, and work-life balance.

Unicamp's ranking stands out for placing a public educational institution in a landscape dominated by large private companies. It also reinforces the success of the University's investments in human resource management, such as encouraging career advancement, preventing abusive practices, managing conflicts, handling transfer processes, including people with disabilities, implementing employee health and workplace safety policies, job readaptation and reintegration, and processes related to managing professional life, in addition to the strong partnership with the HR departments of the Units and Bodies through periodic meetings and specific meetings via the HR Network program.

**Cover photo:**

![In the 2026 edition, the ranking classified 223 universities from 16 countries.](https://www.unicamp.br/wp-content/uploads/sites/33/2025/12/Man_20251203_THE_Alex_Calixto_Matos-0064_Capa-1.jpg)**In the 2026 edition, the ranking classified 223 universities from 16 countries.**

# University of São Paulo | World University Rankings

The University of São Paulo is a large Brazilian public university, and is considered one of country's more prestigious educational institutions.

Founded in 1934, the University of São Paulo came about through a collaboration of existing schools such as the Faculdade de Direito do Largo de São Francisco (Law), the Polytechnic School (Engineering) and the Escola Superior de Agricultura Luiz de Queiroz (Agriculture).

Now, the university has created new departments, and is one of the largest institutions of higher education in Latin America.

Four of its eleven campuses can be found in the city of São Paulo while the remaining campuses are in the cities of Bauru, Lorena, Piracicaba, Pirassununga, Ribeirão Preto and two in São Carlos.

The university has an remarkable 70 libraries installed across the various campuses for students to use and enjoy.

A significant proportion of scientific papers published by Brazilian researchers are produced at the University of São Paulo.

The university also houses five affiliated hospitals, 24 museums and galleries – with half a million visitors per year – two theatres, a cinema, and its own TV channel run by students.

However, the University of São Paulo have no accommodation within campus, or outside. The search for accommodation must be carried out by students in accordance to their economic conditions and interests.

Notable alumni include Antonio Candido de Mello e Souza, a Brazilian writer, professor, sociologist and literary critic, Brazilian lawyer and Vice President Michel Miguel Elias Temer Lulia, and Guido Mantega, Brazil's former Finance Minister.

# USP liderar ranking de melhores universidades brasileiras no QS World University Rankings 2027

## Relatório global aponta Unicamp, UFRJ e Unesp no topo do cenário nacional; curso de Medicina da USP figura entre os 50 melhores do mundo

A USP manteve a liderança entre as universidades brasileiras no QS World University Ranking 2027, acompanhada por Unicamp, UFRJ e Unesp. Veja a classificação.

A [Universidade de São Paulo (USP)](https://www5.usp.br/) consolidou-se novamente como a instituição de ensino superior mais bem classificada do Brasil no [QS World University Rankings 2027](https://www.topuniversities.com/world-university-rankings), divulgado pela consultoria britânica Quacquarelli Symonds (QS). Na classificação global, a [USP](https://www5.usp.br/)ocupa a 133ª colocação geral, o que a posiciona em um patamar de desempenho superior ao de 91,2% das 1.504 instituições de 106 países listadas no relatório. Ao todo, a organização analisou dados de cerca de 9 mil universidades globalmente para a elaboração do indicador.

Embora a [USP](https://discursivas.com/portal/categoria/vestibulares/fuvest/) lidere o cenário nacional, o Escritório de Gestão de Indicadores de Desempenho Acadêmico (Egida) da instituição apontou que houve uma oscilação com queda na posição geral em relação ao ciclo anterior. O comportamento segue uma tendência observada de forma ampla em outras universidades da América Latina, decorrente de atualizações metodológicas e do ingresso de novas instituições competitivas no cenário global. No recorte latino-americano, a USP ocupa a terceira colocação geral, atrás da [Universidade de Buenos Aires (UBA)](https://www.uba.ar/), na 84ª posição, e da [Pontifícia Universidade Católica do Chile](https://www.uc.cl/), na 119ª colocação.

### Desempenho das Universidades Brasileiras e o Top 10 Mundial

O Brasil conta com 22 universidades classificadas na edição de 2027 do ranking da consultoria britânica. No topo do cenário nacional, a liderança permanece com as instituições estaduais paulistas e com as principais federais do país. Atrás da [USP](https://discursivas.com/portal/categoria/vestibulares/fuvest/), a [Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp)](https://discursivas.com/portal/categoria/vestibulares/unicamp/) posiciona-se como a segunda melhor do país, na 277ª colocação global, seguida pela [Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ)](https://ufrj.br/), em 367º lugar, e pela [Universidade Estadual Paulista (Unesp)](https://discursivas.com/portal/categoria/vestibulares/unesp/), na 513ª posição.

Abaixo, a tabela apresenta a estrutura de liderança global do ranking ao lado das principais representantes brasileiras avaliadas no indicador de 2027:

| **Posição Global** | **Instituição** | **País de Origem** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **1º** | Instituto de Tecnologia de Massachusetts (MIT) | Estados Unidos |
| **2º** | Imperial College London | Reino Unido |
| **2º** | Universidade Stanford (empate) | Estados Unidos |
| **4º** | Universidade de Oxford | Reino Unido |
| **5º** | Universidade Harvard | Estados Unidos |

| **7º** | Instituto de Tecnologia da Califórnia (Caltech) | Estados Unidos |
| **8º** | Instituto Federal de Tecnologia da Suíça (ETH Zurich) | Suíça |
| **8º** | Universidade College London (empate) | Reino Unido |
| **10º** | Universidade Nacional de Singapura (NUS) | Singapura |
| **133º** | **Universidade de São Paulo (USP)** | **Brasil** |
| **277º** | **Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp)** | **Brasil** |
| **367º** | **Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ)** | **Brasil** |
| **513º** | **Universidade Estadual Paulista (Unesp)** | **Brasil** |

### O Ranking Técnico das Instituições do Brasil no Indicador QS

A presença do país no relatório restringe-se a um grupo seleto de 22 instituições que atingiram as metas mínimas nos critérios da consultoria britânica. O ordenamento nacional estabelece uma clara concentração de excelência acadêmica nas regiões Sudeste e Sul, evidenciando o peso institucional do tripé estadual paulista ([USP](https://discursivas.com/portal/categoria/vestibulares/fuvest/), [Unicamp](https://discursivas.com/portal/categoria/vestibulares/unicamp/) e [Unesp](https://discursivas.com/portal/categoria/vestibulares/unesp/)) e das universidades federais de grande porte.

Abaixo, apresenta-se o ordenamento das principais forças universitárias brasileiras com base em seus respectivos posicionamentos oficiais no painel global:

1. **Universidade de São Paulo (USP)** – 133ª colocação global
2. **Universidade Estadual de Campinas (Unicamp)** – 277ª colocação global
3. **Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ)** – 367ª colocação global
4. **Universidade Estadual Paulista (Unesp)** – 513ª colocação global

Os resultados são utilizados pelas reitorias como ferramentas de monitoramento e gestão interna, servindo para subsidiar as políticas institucionais de fomento à pesquisa científica, atração de investimentos estrangeiros e ampliação dos programas de internacionalização da graduação e pós-graduação.

### Metodologia de Avaliação e Indicadores de Destaque da USP

O relatório estruturado pela Quacquarelli Symonds baseia-se na análise de artigos acadêmicos, índices de citações científicas e em auditorias de opinião realizadas com docentes e empregadores globalmente. As instituições são monitoradas por meio de nove eixos metodológicos fixos: reputação acadêmica, reputação entre empregadores, proporção de professor por estudante, citações científicas por docente, número de estudantes estrangeiros, corpo docente internacional, sustentabilidade, empregabilidade e rede internacional de pesquisa.

Em quatro desses eixos, a [USP](https://discursivas.com/portal/categoria/vestibulares/fuvest/) conseguiu obter pontuação suficiente para figurar no grupo das 100 melhores instituições do mundo de forma isolada:

- **Reputação Acadêmica:** 39ª posição global.
- **Impacto de Egressos (Empregabilidade):** 50ª posição global.
- **Rede Internacional de Pesquisa:** 58ª posição global.
- **Sustentabilidade:** 91ª posição global.

### Resultados por Áreas Específicas: Destaque em Medicina e Engenharias

Além do ranking de caráter geral, a análise por áreas específicas (QS World University Ranking by Subject) aponta que a [USP](https://discursivas.com/portal/categoria/vestibulares/fuvest/) possui representação entre os principais centros de ensino do mundo em 51 das 55 carreiras avaliadas pela consultoria.

A instituição registrou 11 cursos de graduação e pós-graduação inseridos estritamente no grupo dos 50 melhores do planeta. O principal destaque encontra-se na carreira de História da Arte, que ocupa a 12ª colocação mundial, seguida de perto por Odontologia (15ª), Engenharia de Minas (24ª), Antropologia (25ª) e Biblioteconomia & Gestão de Informação (28ª).

Na área de ciências tecnológicas e da saúde, o curso de Engenharia de Petróleo posicionou-se na 29ª colocação, Agricultura e Silvicultura na 32ª, enquanto as graduações de Medicina e de Farmácia e Farmacologia ocupam o 43º lugar mundial. Completam a lista de excelência o curso de Arquitetura (48ª) e a carreira de Sociologia (50ª).

Na subdivisão por grandes blocos do conhecimento, a [USP](https://discursivas.com/portal/categoria/vestibulares/fuvest/) manteve-se inserida no grupo das 100 melhores em todas as cinco macroáreas avaliadas pelo comitê britânico: Ciências da Vida e Medicina (49ª), Ciência Social e Administração (64ª), Artes e Humanidades (69ª), Engenharia e Tecnologia (74ª) e Ciências Naturais (75ª).
